hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site details for every site (Electricity Hookup '50', Water Hookup 'Y' on all electric sites; e.g. https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/falls-lake-state-recreation-area/r/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=NC&siteId=5097&parkId=552902) + the park notes on every site page ('There are no sewer hookups on any campsites. There is a dump station conveniently located near the entrance to the campground'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The booking site lists 111 sites (the park page says 115): Loops A (27) and B (49) with 50-amp electric and water, Loop C (35) without hookups. 20 pull-throughs; listed driveways run 37-154 ft, and two sites list a 20-ft max vehicle length.

sites.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/falls-lake-state-recreation-area/camping ('Rolling View offers 115 campsites total, 80 with water and 50/30-amp electric hookups') + ReserveAmerica site list and every Rolling View site page (Driveway Entry, Driveway Length, Max Vehicle Length, Electricity Hookup), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/falls-lake-state-recreation-area/camping ('Both Holly Point and Rolling View have a dump station'; 'Bathhouses are centrally located in each camping loop'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Loop A is open all year; Loops B and C opened June 1 and close December 1 in 2026. All campsites are closed December 24 and 25.

season.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/falls-lake-state-recreation-area (Operating Season Schedule 2026, Rolling View Access: 'Campground Loop A Open year-round', 'Campground Loop B June 1, 2026 December 1, 2026', Loop C the same) + https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/falls-lake-state-recreation-area/camping ('All campsites closed December 24 and 25'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Sites can be booked for today and up to 6 months ahead. Holiday weekends need 2 nights, cut to 1 night when booking within 14 days of arrival.

booking.source: https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/falls-lake-state-recreation-area/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NC&parkId=552902 (Booking Window, Campsite Electric / Non-Electric: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 6 Month(s) in advance'; Business Rules for Holiday Weekends: '2 nights Minimum Stay on holiday weekend', '1 night Minimum Stay on holiday weekend if the booking dates within 14 Days before Arrival Date'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Sites without hookups $30 a night and electric/water sites $40, each including the $3-a-night service fee that the booking site adds to its $27 / $37 camping fee (charged on in-person bookings too). Seniors 62+, veterans and military members get $6 off a night with ID at check-in. No out-of-state rate; federal passes are not accepted. Cancelling costs $15 per reservation.

fees.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/about-us/state-parks-reservation-rates-and-activity-fees ('RV with electric and water hookups $40'; 'Tent, trailer, or RV site with no hookups $30'; 'All prices listed on this website page include the $3 service fee'; 'A $3 service fee is charged for all reservations, including those made in-person'; 'Seniors, veterans, and military members are eligible for a $6 discount per night on certain campsite reservations'; 'we do not accept federal passes, such as the America the Beautiful Pass') + ReserveAmerica price breakdowns https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/falls-lake-state-recreation-area/r/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=NC&siteId=5362&parkId=552902 (Loop C site C-001, 2026-11-10: 'Camping Fees (1 night) $27.00 Per Night') and https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/falls-lake-state-recreation-area/r/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=NC&siteId=5097&parkId=552902 (Loop A site A-006, 2026-11-10: '$37.00 Per Night') ('Reservation Fees $3.00 Per Night'), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/about-us/state-parks-reservation-rates-and-activity-fees ('Seniors, veterans, and military members are eligible for a $6 discount per night on certain campsite reservations'; 'we do not accept federal passes, such as the America the Beautiful Pass, or passes for other states'), read 2026-10-22

summary: Added 50-amp electric and water with no sewer, 111 sites (76 electric) with 20 pull-throughs, dump station, year-round season (Loop A; B and C June-December in 2026), ReserveAmerica booking (6-month window, holiday minimum waived within 14 days), $30 / $40 rates and the senior/military discount. Not stated: showers by name.
flags: Site count: ReserveAmerica lists 111 Rolling View sites; ncparks.gov says 115 (80 electric vs 76 on the booking site).
